calls.title: GrowthBook & Neko Health Check in
calls.summary: The meeting centered on positive advancements in the procurement process, highlighted by NECO team endorsements for a data handling platform, with an urgency driven by an upcoming website launch in two weeks. A proposed trial contract with an opt-out clause aims to ease commitment concerns, enabling swift adoption. Technical integration planning involves collaboration with NECO's engineering leads to address existing analytics limitations and ensure smooth implementation. Participants expressed a strong need to commence experimentation immediately post-launch to validate user engagement and improve flows, supported by flexible pricing tiers and payment options to accommodate NECO’s evolving needs. Leadership alignment and clear stakeholder roles were emphasized to foster collaboration and expedite decisions.
calls.keywords: procurement, experimentation, implementation plan, analytics pipeline, trial period, pricing flexibility
